after.zh: IoU 在 0 到 1 之间：1 是完全重合，0 是不沾边。检测器画的框和标注的框 IoU 够大，才算找对了。
after.en: IoU lies between 0 and 1: 1 is a perfect overlap, 0 is not touching at all. A detector's box only counts as right when its IoU with the labelled box is large enough.

t.zh: 目标检测器用一个类别、一个置信度分数和一个边界框描述每个候选物体。类别回答是什么，分数用来给候选排序，框的坐标表示位置与大小。这一关固定类别，只比较预测框和标注框的位置。
t.en: An object detector describes each candidate with a class, a confidence score and a bounding box. The class tells you what it is, the score ranks candidates, and the box coordinates give location and size. This level holds the class fixed and compares the predicted box with a labelled box.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：两个框画成掩膜，输出它们的交并比，公式在说明里。
t.en: Your task in this level: two boxes drawn as masks; output their intersection over union, with the formula in the brief.

desc.zh: 输出两个框掩膜的交并比：重叠面积除以合起来的面积。
desc.en: Outputs the intersection over union of two box masks: the overlap divided by the area they cover together.

brief.zh: 两个框画成掩膜（框里是 1）。输出它们的交并比 IoU = 交集的面积 ÷ 并集的面积。
brief.en: Two boxes drawn as masks (1 inside the box). Output their intersection over union, IoU = area of the intersection ÷ area of the union.

hint.zh: 交集是两张掩膜逐格相乘。并集 = 两个面积相加，再减去重复算的那部分。<part-ref to="mean"></part-ref>量出的面积都差同一个倍数。
hint.en: The intersection is the two masks multiplied cell by cell. The union = the two areas added, minus the part counted twice. Areas measured with <part-ref to="mean"></part-ref> are all off by the same factor.

label.en: A big box round a small one
